name: F84 — Cross-component six-step reasoning: representation versus causal action reachability
scientific_question: For six-step cross-component reachability failures, is the decisive bottleneck online retention/representation under 144 bytes, legal memory action coverage, or answer derivation from an adequate retained state?

admissible_diagnostic_arms.name: Frozen source and solver validity
admissible_diagnostic_arms.method: On already exposed source only, verify the answer against the full immutable 72-event public history, independent graph construction, and deterministic solver.
admissible_diagnostic_arms.purpose: Detect source-label or full-history solver defects without changing the research policy.

admissible_diagnostic_arms.name: Full-history information upper bound
admissible_diagnostic_arms.method: Solve with all 72 public events available offline. Unbounded reference; explicitly NOT an equal-budget competitor.
admissible_diagnostic_arms.purpose: Establish whether the required six-step relationship is encoded in the public event history.

admissible_diagnostic_arms.name: Offline hindsight 144-byte upper bound
admissible_diagnostic_arms.method: Forensic-only query-aware search over legal fixed-width native memory states with at most twelve 12-byte records; full future/query information allowed only offline and labeled as leakage-positive oracle.
admissible_diagnostic_arms.purpose: If a legal retained state suffices offline, distinguish feasible encoding from causal selection failures. Never treat oracle as deployable or as a fair real-time control.

admissible_diagnostic_arms.name: Causal public-prefix 144-byte control
admissible_diagnostic_arms.method: Frozen F60 query-blind online updates, original event order and local_rotate4. Same 144-byte memory and no future/query exposure.
admissible_diagnostic_arms.purpose: Fix the known control at equal capacity and causal information boundary.

admissible_diagnostic_arms.name: Legal action reachability decomposition
admissible_diagnostic_arms.method: On already exposed synthetic cases only, enumerate legal source-native local updates and audit bridge visibility, first irreversible deletion, component joins, and final solver dependency. Do not select from hindsight during an online run.
admissible_diagnostic_arms.purpose: Determine if a useful local action sequence exists but is not chosen, or if current legal action representation cannot preserve required structure.

diagnostic_decision_tree: D0 failure means invalidate interpretation and repair source/evaluator identity before further scientific claims.
D1 failure means a source/solver/task construction issue; do not blame memory capacity or train a new selector.
D1 pass + D2 fail suggests a 144-byte encoding/action-space limitation, but cannot by itself isolate which; report insufficient or unachievable under tested legal states.
D2 pass + D3 fail implies that offline feasible memory exists while real-time causal policy or observation selection may be inadequate. Hindsight success is not evidence of causal learnability.
D3 pass in any analyzed case means verify task/arrival stratification before claiming a universal cross-component failure.
Any D4 conclusion must be bounded to the exact evaluated exposed seeds, frozen solver, legal actions and memory format.
controls: Treat old F83 synthetic seeds (-5121 through -5136, families -2/-1) as consumed and use solely for read-only forensic diagnostics.
Do not train, fit, select hyperparameters, set new scientific thresholds, or report prospective generalization based on the already exposed guard.
No future task/query information may enter D3 or any proposed future deployed policy; D2 uses deliberate offline hindsight and must be labeled.
No changes to the 144-byte budget, 12-record format, 72-event causal prefix audit, frozen F60, underlying F83 source or past classifications.
Preregister source-birth, independent first-use admission, unseen held-out evaluation, equal-budget controls and one full regression before any genuinely new original test.
Fail closed on missing provenance or ambiguous exact commit/blob identity. No duplicate replay claimed as independent replication.
